name: 78852 · Eagle Pass, TX
findings: ZIP 78852 (Eagle Pass) has 42 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 11 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 78852 (Eagle Pass) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 78852 (Eagle Pass) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 29% of the typical level).
